reviewed_by: Static review of the retail instruction sequence against the corrected candidate source

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Radare2 (3 blocks/2 edges, 74 bytes, cdecl), the existing Binary Ninja record and angr CFGFast agree on entry 0x00405850; the candidate implements that entry.

checks.name: abi_and_return
checks.rationale: The only argument at [esp+4] is the path passed straight to Qvm_Load; the function is cdecl. Its EAX is the final Config_Language_2 result on both paths, which the candidate returns as int32_t; the only retail caller (0x004020C9) discards it.

checks.name: branch_split
checks.rationale: Retail tests the Qvm_Load result at 0x00405862 and enters the success block at 0x00405864 when it is non-null, otherwise the failed-load block at 0x00405884. The candidate's `if (qvm == nullptr)` inverts the test the same way: the failure block is the null branch.

checks.name: success_call_order
checks.rationale: Success calls Qvm_Execute(qvm) at 0x00405865, Qvm_Cleanup(qvm) at 0x0040586B, cleans 8 bytes at 0x00405870, then calls 0x004058A0, 0x00405980 and 0x00405B30 in that order. The candidate calls the same functions in the same order and does not call 0x00405300 on this path.

checks.name: failure_call_order
checks.rationale: The failed-load block calls 0x00405300 at 0x00405889, 0x004058A0 at 0x0040588E, 0x00405980 at 0x00405893 and 0x00405B30 at 0x00405898. The candidate calls Config_SaveGraphicOptions, Config_SaveSoundOptions, Config_NoD3DDriversWithHard and Config_Language_2 in exactly that order, so the graphic-options save is failure-only.

checks.name: callee_declarations
checks.rationale: The four callees are declared with the retail cdecl signatures; Config_Language_2 is int32_t because its EAX becomes Config_Read's result, while the other three are declared void because every call site discards their EAX.

checks.name: link_status
checks.rationale: The four callees are separate untranscribed retail natives, so this unit does not link. See docs/fidelity/evidence/humanplayer-defines-link-blockers.json.

differences: The tail call to Config_Language_2 replaces retail's call-plus-ret; the value returned is the same.
status_limits: Static and structural evidence only; the four callees cannot run yet and no runtime capture was made.
